notes.title: Release Villienville. Echoes of Deception!
notes.notes:
[h2]Villienville. Echoes of Deception Released![/h2]

After a long period of development, we have finally released "Villienville. Echoes of Deception". This is our first experience in narrative games and we really hope that you will like it.

We will be very glad to receive any feedback in reviews or in the community!
